about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, footprint geometry). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 Nano pinout, C1 polarity, the 5 mm LEDs, J1 servo pinout, the THT buttons) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: OK for state 2d82925b… (gate run 20261026-114555): resistor ratings (R8/R9 0.25 W of 1 W, about 50 °C), every lead against its hole from the drill file (play 0.115–0.54 mm), buttons C110153 pins 1/2 and 3/4 connected (HRO drawing, cannot be soldered in wrong), 5 mm LEDs, C1, J1, U1 as on the main board. Notes: S1/S2 holes 1.3 mm against 1.0 mm recommended – press the button flat while soldering; C110153 lead thickness 0.30 mm is a drawing value; stale lines in C439782/C9900187880 for the next circuit change.

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: OK for layout hash d0021b33… (gate run 20261026-123036; first review of 660dee04… OK with notes, then 12 mil clearance, bottom-preferred layer cost and the order-number placeholder): smallest track-to-pad gap 0.310 mm, mask webs ≥ 0.184 mm, one tented via under the Nano, rings ≥ 0.26 mm, L-9 for all 71 holes, spokes on every GND pad. Notes: S1/S2 holes 1.3 mm (press flat while soldering); the top carries about 0.36 m of track (like the main board); order with 'Order Number (Specify Position)'.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: board preview and price (bare board, no assembly)
Acceptance of every soldered board: visual check, Nano plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings
